notes:
Account profile: mid- to large-cap fintech focused on consumer lending and account servicing. Tight regulatory requirements for customer PII and transaction logs. Primary ask: private VPC deployment (no public endpoints), KMS integration for token encryption, audit logs shipped to their SIEM, and strict egress controls.

Security review status: questionnaire submitted 2025-12-02 (SEC-QA-auric v3), 3rd-party penetration test requested — vendor shortlist pending. Emphasized need for data residency: US for production, EU for EU customers (must support region isolation).

Networking constraints: Auric requires either AWS PrivateLink or VPC peering (prefers PrivateLink for least blast radius). Must provide fixed egress IP ranges to populate their outbound allowlist and firewall policies. They also want optional on-prem connector for disaster recovery in 2nd phase.

KMS: Auric uses AWS KMS with multi-account key policy and HSM-backed CMKs for highest tier data. They asked whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (CMKs) and key rotation audit hooks — SE confirmed supported via KMS integration + audit logging to CloudTrail.

Quote from CISO: "We cannot accept shared, unaudited key material or unknown egress ranges — everything must be auditable and scoped to our tenancy."

Commercial: leaning toward 12-month dedicated + private combination. Price sensitivity moderate; willing to pay premium for isolation and SLA. Requested detailed SOW for private deployment with per-region residency guarantee.

Typical CRM shorthand seen in notes/log: "POC w/ private-link succesful (latency 45–65ms avg), KMS stubbed, waiting legal redlines. Ask: egress IPs + FW template. Next: security addendum + commercial SOW."
